newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Polar Mines rises by 42.86 pct in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Polar Mines rises by 42.86 pct in Manila.

text.p: Polar Mines and Development Corp rose by 4.50 centavos, or 42.86 percent, to 15 centavos in late trade on Monday, brokers said.
"It's the usual rumour of a foreign firm buying into the company," Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital, said.
"There is also this talk going around that the company will be transformed into a holding firm of an existing mass housing builder," said another broker who asked not to be named.
Polar Mines officials could not be reached for comment.
In late trade, Polar was the most actively traded counter with volume of shares traded totalling 1.27 million.
